Silent reading is not only about scanning; you can also「声を立ち上げて」read

Silent reading is not one mode. We can scan for a target, read for meaning, or mentally simulate a speaker's voice and timing. 黙読研究、regional accent、talker-specific auditory imagery、implicit prosody、skimmingのeye-tracking研究をつなぎながら、「速く読む／遅く読む」ではなく、文章に何を問いかけるかでreading modeを切り替える方法を考える。
